scores.notes: Peter is the man leaping from the boat (left) and the standing man with the net by the fire (right): both have short curly dark hair greying at the temples, a greying short beard, weathered middle-aged face and stocky build in a brown coat.

Both show the same open wooden fishing boat with a single mast, patched cream sail and rope-bound stern post on a dark choppy lake under storm cloud with low hilly shores; the right only adds the clearing asked for.

Same kind of wooden plank boat with single rope-wrapped mast on a wave-tossed lake ringed by low hills under dark storm cloud; the left shows brightening sky as the calm asked for, the sail is simply out of frame.

Both show a dark storm-clouded teal sea opening onto a wet sandy, rock-strewn seabed; the left is the shore view as the waters begin to divide and the right is the corridor between the risen walls, a compatible later viewpoint.

Same dark storm sky, grey-green heaving sea and wet brown seabed strewn with weed; the left looks from the near shore (palms, distant walled town) and the right down the corridor to a far red-cliff shore, which do not conflict.

Both show a sandy wet seabed corridor between towering blue-green water walls under broken cloud, ending at red mesa cliffs on the shore; the scrub on the right-hand ground is a minor difference only.
Both show a sandy, puddled seabed path between tall curling blue-green water walls with a tan/red bluff at the shore end; the left sky is stormier but the terrain, puddles and water walls match.

Daniel (standing by the angel, left; holding the rope, right) is in both an older brown-skinned man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, slim build, in the same blue robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder bag.

The house conflicts: left is a stone and half-timbered gabled cottage with tall chimneys, right is a cream clapboard house with a columned porch and shutters; the table is also bare wood on the left and cloth-covered on the right.

Both show dry Galilean hill country with olive trees, a pale dirt road and flat-roofed stone houses; the left is the road some way off with the farmstead in the distance, the right is the yard of such a house, a compatible closer viewpoint.

Moses (centre with staff, left; on the rock with raised staff, right) is in both an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, same build, cream tunic and dark brown cloak; hair looks more windswept and longer on the right but no clear cue conflicts.

Both show a sandy, rock-and-weed-strewn seabed opening between curling blue-green water walls under storm cloud; the right is the shore view with wind-bent palms as the sea divides, the left the corridor toward far red cliffs, a compatible change of viewpoint.

Daniel (hauled up on the rope, left; standing in the light shaft, right) is in both a lean older man with short grey hair, trimmed grey beard and tan skin, wearing the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a small bag.

Both show a pale dawn lake ringed by tawny hills with a pebbly shore, a small fire on the beach and a wooden fishing boat just offshore; the palms and houses seen from the water on the right would be out of frame in the left's along-shore view.

Both show a sand corridor through green-teal curling sea walls ending at pale sand dunes on the shore; the left is a higher, drier, stormier-skied view with lower walls and the right adds red cliffs, but land, water and dunes are compatible.

Jesus (crouching at the fire, left; standing in the boat, right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face and age, and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.

The house conflicts: left is a pale grey rendered house with sash windows and a pedimented doorway, right is a red-brick half-timbered cottage with a tiled roof and arched door; the cloth is embroidered on the left and plain white on the right.

Both show the same grey-green heaving sea dividing to expose a tan sandy, rock-strewn bed under grey storm cloud; the left is the near-shore view as the path opens and the right looks along the corridor to a dune shore, with no conflicting feature.

Both show a sandy, rock- and weed-littered seabed beside dark blue-green breaking sea on a desert shore; the right (the all-night parting) is much darker-skied with palms on the bank, the left is the opened corridor in grey daylight, and the land and water are compatible.

Moses (pointing from the bank, left; front centre with staff, right) is in both an elderly man with shoulder-length white hair and a long full white beard, same build and tanned skin, in a cream tunic with a brown cloak.

Both show a hill-ringed lake shore with a stony bank, reeds at the waterline, a small fire and the same wooden boat close in under heavy cloud; the left is sunlit with a hillside village behind and the right dimmer and seen along the beach, but nothing in the land or water conflicts.

Both show a broad mown lawn with ridges and stripes, enclosed by a low garden wall with tall parkland trees and shrubs behind and card-soldier hoops scattered about; the wall reads greyer on the left and redder brick on the right, a minor difference.

The lake, storm and hills agree, but the boat itself conflicts: on the left the stern where Jesus sleeps ends in a short plain rope-bound post, on the right it rises into a tall carved scroll finial with a different, heavier hull.

Daniel (beside the angel, left; being lifted from the pit, right) is in both an older lean man with short cropped grey hair and a short grey beard in a blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder bag; skin reads a little darker on the left but no clear cue conflicts.

Both show a grassy ridged croquet lawn bounded by a garden wall with large leafy trees, shrubs and hoops played by card soldiers; the right is seen from under a tree with a greyer wall and hedge, a compatible corner of the same walled ground.

Daniel (climbing the rope, left; standing among the lions, right) is in both a lean older man with short grey hair and a trimmed grey beard, tan skin, in the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a belt pouch.

Peter (standing by the fire with the net over his shoulder, left; leaping from the boat, right) has in both curly dark hair heavily streaked grey, a short grizzled beard, a weathered middle-aged face and sturdy build, with a rough brown coat.

The house conflicts: left is a pale grey rendered house with sash windows and a pedimented door, right is a red-brick half-timbered tiled cottage with a gabled porch; the table is cloth-covered on the left and bare wood on the right.

The house conflicts: left is a thatched, rose-covered half-timbered cottage, right is a grey clapboard house with a columned veranda; the table is a short one on the left and a very long laid table on the right.

Both show a rough tufted lawn enclosed by a pinkish brick garden wall with tall cypress-like and leafy trees behind, hedgehogs and hoops in play; the right adds a topiary arch and a wet patch but the walled ground is compatible.

The den's structure conflicts: left is a roofed, dome-shaped stone chamber narrowing to a small round opening beside a barred window, right is a wide open-topped cylinder of pale blocks with vertical walls, a hinged wooden cover and a straw floor.

Daniel (standing among the lions, left; held by the soldiers on the rope, right) is in both an older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, slim build, in a blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder bag.

Both show a rough grassy croquet lawn inside a walled garden with clipped hedges, cypresses and big leafy trees, card soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs about; the right is seen from under a tree with more furrowed turf, a compatible viewpoint.

Both show a tan sandy seabed with weed, shells and rocks opening through blue-green sea by a desert shore with reddish cliffs; the left is the dark stormy night of the parting from the bank and the right the opened corridor in grey daylight, with no conflicting land feature.
Both show a lush uneven green lawn enclosed by the same red-brick garden wall with mature leafy trees behind it under a cloudy sky, with playing-card hoops and flamingos in play.

Both show the same style of open wooden plank boat with plain upright stem and stern posts and a single rope-stayed mast, on a grey-green choppy lake under storm cloud with green-brown hills and a shoreline village behind; the left only shows the clearing sky asked for.

Both show a dark storm-lit teal sea opened over a wet, rocky, weed-strewn brown seabed under heavy black cloud; the left looks along the corridor between the towering walls and the right from the cliff-backed bank as the path opens, which are compatible.

Both show a mown, striped green lawn inside a low grey-brown garden wall with dense parkland trees and shrubs behind, with card-soldier hoops dotted across it; the right is just a closer view with bare patches.

Peter (plunging from the boat, left; standing by the fire holding the net, right) has in both short dark curly hair going grey, a short grizzled beard, a tanned weathered middle-aged face and sturdy build, in a rough brown outer coat.

Both show a dark-timbered open boat with a rope-bound mast, coiled ropes and Jesus on a cushion in the stern, swamped by white-capped blue-black waves under black storm cloud; the left is a closer, darker view with no shore in frame but nothing conflicts.

The pale clapboard house with a porch and the big tree agree, but the tea table itself conflicts: left is a short bare plank table with crockery heaped on the grass beneath, right is a long table covered by a stained white cloth.

Both show the same plank-built boat with a rope-lashed stern post and single stayed mast in steep blue-green waves under dark rain cloud with scrubby green hills behind; the sail is above the frame on the left and visible on the right.

Both show sunlit dry hill country with terraced slopes, olive trees, cypresses, a pale dirt road and flat-roofed pale stone houses with low stone walls; the left is the road outside the village, the right the yard among those houses.

Both show a storm-dark teal sea split over a wet tan seabed beside a dry desert coast; the left looks down the corridor toward red cliffs and the right from the palm-fringed bank as the waters open, viewpoints that do not conflict.

Both show a deep circular pit lined with large grey ashlar blocks, open to daylight at a rim where the king and guards lean over, with lions on a bare dirt floor; the left is the view from the courtyard above and the right from the floor, with only part of the top arched over.

Both show a rough tufted lawn enclosed by the same long pinkish garden wall with dark cypresses and leafy trees behind under a pale cloudy sky, with hedgehogs and hoops; the right adds a shallow furrow but is compatible.

Peter (the dripping-wet man in the ragged brown coat facing Jesus, left; the man leaping from the boat, right) has in both short curly hair, a grizzled short beard, weathered tanned face and stocky build; his hair reads greyer on the right but the beard, face and age band agree.

Moses (pointing from the bank, left; centre front with staff, right) is in both an elderly man with swept-back white hair and a long full white beard, tanned lined face and same build, in a cream tunic with a dark brown cloak.

Both show dry terraced hill country with olive trees, pale dirt ground, dry-stone walls and flat-roofed pale stone houses; the left is the road with the houses in the distance and the right the yard among them, a compatible closer viewpoint.

Both show the same plank-built open boat with a rope-lashed stern post, long oars and a single stayed mast on a dark blue wave-tossed lake under storm cloud with scrubby hills on both shores; the left only adds the clearing asked for.

Jesus (standing in the boat, left; crouching at the fire, right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same lean face, age and skin tone, and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.
